author: Peter Santenello
description:
► Get my book Your Fellow Americans here: https://www.amazon.com/Your-Fellow-Americans-Dispatches-Country/dp/1668214342/

Out in Washington’s San Juan Islands is Orcas Island, a place where eccentric people without cell phones live alongside billionaires, musicians, artists, and others who have chosen a simpler way of life. They come from very different worlds, but share a desire to live away from it all, surrounded by some of the most beautiful scenery in the world. Join me as we head out to Orcas Island for a day to cruise around, meet the locals, and get a feel for what life is like here.
